name: Facet Wheelbase
description: Stand with the beam upright between both courts of bearers and salute the target, drawing qi into the arms.

name: Logglimmer
description: Step round the beam in an alternating ring so each court's bearers cross without losing the carry.

name: Ramcap Insight
description: Judge the door's thickness from the sound of the first light tap and the echo it throws back.

name: Blazebeam
description: Drive the ram on one court's count and answer on the other's, so the door has no time to settle between blows.

name: Indomitable Carryhandle
description: Lock the haft between two bearers' arms and hold fast as defenders try to seize the beam's head.

name: Boughblink
description: Shift the whole carry from slow court pace to a charging pace, the lead court's qi lifting the other.

name: Novalog
description: Strike the door at hinge and lock from two courts at once, the combined drive tearing the leaf from its frame.

name: Berserk Hammerin
description: Keep up a cadence of blows voiced from court to court that never lets the door rest, qi passing between them.

name: Devastating Nova Swayswing
description: Gather both courts' qi into the beam during a held count, then loose one stroke that caves the door's inner brace and frame.

name: Silt Endknob
description: Carry the beam with arms spread along its length like a hawk's wings, balanced and ready to turn.

name: Unconquered Bandring
description: Halt in a low perched crouch behind the beam, qi pooling in the legs while missiles pass overhead.

name: Keen Ramcap
description: Lift the head and read the draught at the door's edge for hidden defenders and the bar's position.

name: Equipoise Wheelbase
description: Close curled fingers over the haft and lift the beam's head to the height of the door's lock.

name: Torrent Shudder
description: Dive down a slope toward the door with the beam lowered, striking as the run's speed peaks.

name: Chime Headcap
description: Beat the haft sideways like a wing to knock aside a thrown spear and strike the foe behind it.

name: Thorn Pounddown
description: Clamp the beam's iron cap on a defender's grappling hook and pull with the crew until the line goes slack.

name: Might Beamdrive
description: Ride a rising lift of qi under the beam and drive its head upward into a lintel.

name: Blistering Slingchain
description: Pick the door's weakest seam at a glance and send the whole beam's force through it as one narrow thrust.

name: Meteoric Hammerin
description: Fold forward in a blink of qi-driven speed, arriving at the door with the cap already driving through it.

name: Slingchain Premonition
description: Draw the slung ram back along two ropes at once, each track holding half the weight.

name: Granite Smitedown
description: Step across the two tracks of chain and rope without tangling them as the ram swings through.

name: Remnant Carryhandle
description: Estimate a gate leaf's weight from how far it flexes under a tap and size the swing to match.

name: Impervious Beamhead
description: Squat with a back to each track post so the swinging log's side thrust cannot throw the crew.

name: Iron Ramtail
description: Release the first track's ram so it strikes the gate's weak plank and tests its resonance.

name: Blazeramcap
description: Release the second track's ram a heartbeat after the first so the gate shivers at its own rhythm.

name: Blinding Endknob
description: Slide between the two tracks as a sally runs at one, leaving only the swinging log in the defender's path.

name: Revitalizing Ramhorn
description: Pass the chain's weight between tracks as one tires, so the line never sags and qi reaches the lagging hands.

name: Vital Endknob
description: Haul both tracks together with qi poured into the rope, the ram rising to a higher arc than either could manage alone.

name: Novabough
description: Release both tracks' rams at the gate's two straps so iron and plank give way along both lines.

name: Intent Pounddown
description: Lock both tracks against the gate and shove forward until its bar bows inward and the line advances.

name: Unsparing Swayswing
description: Hold both rams high while the crews gather qi, then release them together so the leaves burst apart and the doorway is swept clear.

name: Impervious Ramhorn
description: Grip the twin rails of the roofed frame so it does not skid when the ram is released.

name: Verity Carryhandle
description: Listen to arrows and stones thudding on the hide roof to learn where defenders stand.

name: Gust Hammerin
description: Move two frames forward side by side at an interval that lets each shield the other's flank.

name: Unbowed Slingchain
description: Hammer ground pegs against the frame's feet so the roofed ram holds still on the swing.

name: Prescient Headcap
description: Whisper the pace count beneath the roof so each frame's crew works in time with the other.

name: Pitiless Pounddown
description: Swing the rams in the two frames in alternation, beating the door like a drum until its brackets loosen.

name: Murk Beamhead
description: Fling qi-driven water across the roof hide so a thrown fire is smothered before it spreads.

name: Unrelenting Ramtail
description: Chain one frame's side brace to the other's, so a toppling push from defenders cannot overturn either.

name: Unsparing Shudder
description: Strike from both frames in turn without a pause, the crews sharing qi so neither tires.

name: Ramcapvortex
description: Advance the paired frames abreast to form one unbroken roofed line over the approach to the door.

name: Beamdrive Scourge
description: Draw both rams to their rear stops, gather the frames' qi in one count and loose them to shatter door and brace together.

name: Hoarfrost Bandring
description: Stand with the knees bent like the basin's curve, the beam resting level across the shoulders.

name: Mightbough
description: Carry in a gently flowing pace, the bearers' footfalls following one another like a river's ripples.

name: Waning Beamhead
description: Feel the pull and eddy of the crew's weight through the beam to find a bearer who lags.

name: Sanguine Smitedown
description: Tap the cap lightly along the door in a flowing line, listening for the plank that rings false.

name: Ramvortex
description: Retreat over loose ground by placing each foot like a stepping stone, the beam never dipping.

name: Rampaging Wheelbase
description: Build the carry's pace like rapids narrowing, then unleash the whole weight on a single blow.

name: Murk Ramtail
description: Turn the beam in a small eddy to catch a hurled spear on its flank while the crew steps aside.

name: Unbowed Bandring
description: Hold the ram still in the basin of the crew's own stance, pinning the door's bar against its brackets.

name: Daybreak Ramcap
description: Pull the beam back with a slow backwater haul, the crew sharing qi so it can be driven again at once.

name: Rumble Shudder
description: Curve the carry like a river's bend to strike a door from the side its defenders leave unguarded.

name: Hour Swayswing
description: Push the line forward behind the beam like rising floodwater, its pressure folding the barricade.

name: Wheelbase Wrath
description: Bring the beam down on the door's centre so the shock spreads through the frame and knocks down everyone nearby.

name: Titanic Smitedown
description: Gather the crew's qi like a swollen river held back, then release it in one drive that bursts the barrier.

name: Carryhandle Vitality
description: Check the beam's level and the crew's alignment with one sweeping look before the order to lift.

name: Might Slingchain
description: Lift the beam's end with a spine held straight so the weight passes into the hips and into qi.

name: Siltram
description: Walk to the door with a poised pace that tells defenders nothing of the coming rush.

name: Boughhavoc
description: Touch the cap to the door's lock at the exact instant the crew halts, setting the line for the drive.

name: Verity Endknob
description: Tap a short sequence across the door and read from the echoes where bar, bolts and braces lie.

name: Chime Ramcap
description: Turn the ram's recoil along the haft into the crew's legs and let it spring them into a second drive.

name: Energizing Headcap
description: Change the crew's cadence by a sharp word mid-advance and carry them from walk to rush without a stumble.

name: Facetram
description: Drive the ram down a perfectly straight line so every ounce of force arrives at one point on the door.

name: Obdurate Ramhorn
description: Meet a defender's push against the door with a surge that returns his force through the beam and sends him reeling.

name: Ironlog
description: Draw the beam back without a word, hold one breath with the crew, then drive it through door and bar at once.

name: Charter Bandring
description: Plant both feet at the oath's word and hold the beam as a sworn bearer holds a promise.

name: Ramblink
description: Walk to the door on the sworn breath, each step falling as the oath's syllables are spoken.

name: Clairvoyant Headcap
description: Tap the sill with the cap to hear whether the floor beneath the door is stone or timber.

name: Lacerating Pounddown
description: Strike the door on the oath's first word so the sound and the blow arrive together.

name: Beamscourge
description: Link each bearer's oath word to a stroke of the beam, the qi passing along the chain of voices.

name: Aegis Ramcap
description: Hold the beam against the door through the foe's counter-shove, the sworn crew refusing to yield an inch.

name: Siltlog
description: Step aside on the wind's witness as defenders strike, letting their blows fall on the beam's cap alone.

name: Glint Smitedown
description: Fulfil the oath with a single blow, qi gathered at the cap, that splits the bar from the door's frame.

name: Silt Swayswing
description: Advance the sworn line behind the beam, qi passing hand to hand so no bearer falls.

name: Hellish Hammerin Ruin
description: Speak the final oath, gather qi through the crew, and loose one stroke that bursts the barrier and sweeps the entry clear.

name: Facet Ramtail
description: Set the beam on the shoulder facing the wind so the gusts steady it rather than push it.

name: Beamvortex
description: Lean forward with the gale and walk the beam up to the door with the wind speeding every step.

name: Revitalizing Beamhead
description: Watch dust and leaves at the door's foot to learn where the draught slips through a gap.

name: Novabeam
description: Thrust the cap into the gap where the draught slips through, splitting the door along its weakest line.

name: Equipoise Endknob
description: Pivot the beam so a gust fills its side and carries thrown stones past the crew.

name: Vital Ramhorn
description: Spread a hide sheet over the beam's back so the gale pushes it on, qi steadying each bearer's grip.

name: Rumbleram
description: Time the drive to a gale's peak so wind and beam arrive at the door together and the bolts shear.

name: Shade Wheelbase
description: Press the crew's line abreast across open ground into the door, the gale at their backs bowing the barrier.

name: Ramcapscourge
description: Gather the crew's qi as the gale builds, then release a stroke that bursts the door and scatters its defenders.

name: Galvanizing Carryhandle
description: Halt a moment to take a fresh bearing on the door's lock from two fixed marks.

name: Gust Beamdrive
description: Stride along the held bearing with eyes on the mark, the beam kept level on the crew's shoulders.

name: Aegis Slingchain
description: Hold the beam plumb before the chest while the crew's feet settle behind its girth.

name: Resurgent Ramtail
description: Call out any drift of the line from the bearing so the crew corrects before the final run.

name: Shattering Beamdrive
description: Strike the lock-plate on the bearing's exact mark with the first drive of the approach.

name: Blaze Hammerin
description: Fix the bearing with a breath-held pause, then drive so the cap strikes the same spot twice.

name: Waning Ramcap
description: Cross two bearings on the door and shift the whole crew to the point where the lines meet.

name: Ramglimmer
description: Slide the crew back to the held bearing when a foe's rush shifts the line, turning his push aside.

name: Ruinous Hammerin
description: Hold the bearing against the door with unwavering pressure until the bolts bend and the bar bows.

name: Tempered Shudder
description: Strike the door on a bearing held through the whole run, qi gathered along it, splitting bar and bolts.

name: Logflash
description: Enter along the held bearing with the beam sweeping low, clearing the doorway's flanks of defenders.

name: Colossal Smitedown
description: Hold the bearing through a long still breath while qi gathers, then loose one drive that breaches door and frame.

name: Ramhorn Nerve
description: Crouch with the beam braced on the plateau's lip so a gust cannot lift the crew from the ground.

name: Ramcapblink
description: Shuffle with flat feet over frozen ground so the carry never slips.

name: Slingchain Insight
description: Read the wind curling over the lip to learn where defenders stand upwind of the door.

name: Ruinous Shudder
description: Shove the ram into a foe standing near the edge so the push carries him back.

name: Invincible Wheelbase
description: Tilt the beam against the low sun so the glare off its cap blinds a defender's aim.

name: Obdurate Carryhandle
description: Lean the crew's weight back against the beam's head to keep it from tipping over the plateau's edge.

name: Daybreak Bandring
description: Use the updraft along the cliff face to ease the beam's lift while qi fills the bearers' arms.

name: Vengeful Swayswing
description: Skim along the lip with the beam low and strike a door's side before defenders can turn.

name: Boughruin
description: Drive the cap into the door as a gust crests the lip, wind and blow splitting the planks together.

name: Granite Beamhead
description: Rush the crew over open ground behind the beam, the sweep of its tail knocking down any who stand in the way.

name: Mangling Headcap
description: Draw the crew's qi in with the rising wind, then loose one stroke that shatters the door and flings its bar outward.

name: Iron Bandring
description: Hold the beam upright in a gale's teeth with an oath that the grip will not slip.

name: Mightlog
description: Step with the gale's pulse so each footfall lands on a gust and finds sure footing.

name: Intent Wheelbase
description: Count three gusts aloud and release the carry on the third so the crew moves as one.

name: Remnant Beamhead
description: Rest the cap against the door and feel its tremble to tell how many hold the bar inside.

name: Ramcaphavoc
description: Drive the beam in a flat line that cuts across the gust so the blow does not drift.

name: Siltbough
description: Run with the gale at the crew's back and release the ram at the end of the run.

name: Unerring Endknob
description: Bind the crew together with a sworn call so qi passes freely and no bearer breaks away.

name: Impenetrable Endknob
description: Turn the beam into a crosswind to shear off an arrow volley and swing the head back on the door.

name: Intentram
description: Hold the ram pressed hard against the door while the gale pins the leaves shut against their frame.

name: Hollowbeam
description: Fulfil the sworn count with a drive that splits the bolted door as the gust peaks.

name: Boughglimmer
description: Surge through the breach with the beam swinging wide in the gale's direction, bowling over defenders on the leeward side.

name: Blistering Swayswing
description: Press the sworn line forward with the gale behind it until nothing the defenders brace can stand.

name: Corroding Shudder
description: Swear the gale's name into the beam, gather every bearer's qi, then loose a stroke that bursts the barrier outward.

name: Hoarfrost Ramcap
description: Hold the beam across the chest in a posture that tells the crew the oath has begun.

name: Hammerin Flash
description: Set the pace to the wind's rhythm, slowing in lulls and quickening with each gust.

name: Carryhandle Respite
description: Read the shadow of the bar through a plank gap and judge how thick and how well seated it is.

name: Blaze Beamdrive
description: Release a short breath with the blow so the wind carries the sound of the strike away.

name: Beamhavoc
description: Speak the oath at the blow's moment so the crew's qi gathers behind it.

name: Torrent Ramtail
description: Spread the crew's cloaks along the beam to catch the wind and turn aside thrown fire.

name: Torrential Pounddown
description: Pivot the whole beam with the wind's shift to jam a bar that has begun to slide.

name: Hollowram
description: Join wind and oath in one drive, the beam splitting the door's bar from its brackets.

name: Silt Slingchain
description: Heave the beam forward in a sustained advance, the sworn crew's qi never flagging until the door gives.

name: Titanic Headcap
description: Call the last wind into the beam with a held breath, then loose a stroke that scatters door and defenders alike.
